strong.note: Long specific answers: no follow-ups, every criterion scored with a verified quote.

average.note: Short answers without outcomes: follow-ups expected.

vague.note: Vague answers: follow-ups, never more than 2 per question.

evasive.note: Off-topic answers: one polite rephrase, then move on.

idk.note: 'I don't know': no follow-up, gap flagged for the human.
